gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically or radiographically confirmed recurrent CNS WHO grade 4 IDH wild-type glioma following standard of care treatment including radiation, chemotherapy, and/or tumor-treating fields.

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a phase IB/II, open-label study evaluating CTX-009 as monotherapy and in combination with CTX-471.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Safety and Efficacy of CTX-009 With or Without CTX-471 for Recurrent Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Phase IB Arm 1: CTX-009 monotherapy: CTX-009 will be given intravenously at the assigned dose level on an outpatient basis every 2 weeks of a 28-day cycle.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: CTX-009 expands on existing anti-angiogenic therapies by ablating key compensatory and resistance mechanisms to bevacizumab
arms: Phase IB Arm 2: CTX-009 and CTX-471 combination therapy
Phase II Expansion Arm 1: CTX-009 monotherapy
Phase II Expansion Arm 2: CTX-009 and CTX-471 combination therapy

role_evidence.quote: CTX-471 will be given intravenously at a dose of 0.3 mg/kg every 2 weeks (day 1 and day 15).

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: CTX-471 restores local immune reactivity through activation of costimulatory immune mediators
arms: Phase IB Arm 2: CTX-009 and CTX-471 combination therapy
Phase II Expansion Arm 2: CTX-009 and CTX-471 combination therapy

source_quote.quote: recurrent CNS WHO grade 4 IDH wild-type glioma

coder_notes: CTX-009 (tovecimig) is the only investigational agent in the Arm 1 arms (experimental_monotherapy) but one of two in the Arm 2 arms (experimental_combination there). CTX-471 is investigational only in Arm 2 arms. Regimen coded combination because Arm 2 combines both; Arm 1 is monotherapy. Allocation registered as randomized but all arms experimental; no control arm. IDH-wildtype only defines GBM.
